'''Alar''' is an [[Ogier]] [[Elder]] of [[Stedding Tsofu|''Stedding'' Tsofu]]. She is the Eldest of the Elders. She is very old. She is the grandmother of [[Erith]] and mother of [[Iva]].

== Activities ==
She lets [[Rand al'Thor]] and his group use the [[Waygate]] outside ''Stedding'' Tsofu, although very reluctantly.{{ref/book|2|36}}
